result: Implemented exposure-comparison protocol v2. Candidate fingerprinting is explicitly a coarse reduced-composition + site-count SHA256 bucket and cannot authorize exact membership. Authoritative exact and near-duplicate verdicts use frozen pymatgen StructureMatcher configurations. Prototype grouping is bound to Matbench Discovery commit 26d3a19073df8cb303c7e4849a0d65e74746d9eb, moyopy 0.3.4, and verified upstream Git blobs. The sAlex builder can invoke the frozen executors, but production indexing and exposure-audit claims remain closed.
